paragraphs: Rabbi Zerika, in Abbahu’s time. Yirmeyah told Zerika,“When you enter before Abbahu, raise this contradiction”: Yevamot 42b. “Rabbi Zerika’s collection,”chapter Hasholeach Get 44a: Rashi, the Mishnah arranged for you. He reported Rabbi Abba, who reported Rabbi Taddai: Kirah 38, beginning of side b. Abba said to him: Bava Batra 130b. He reported Elazar: Zevachim 93b; Menachot 7b, 86b; Yoma 4b; Sotah 4b. Rabbi Zerikan. Yochanan, in Elazar son of Yose HaGelili’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, beginning of Ein Omedin. In Ammi bar Natan’s time. He reported Ammi, who reported Yehoshua ben Levi, two matters: Berakhot 3b. In Jerusalem Talmud there, mishnah 1, that matter is in Resh Lakish’s name. Zerika reported Ammi, who reported Resh Lakish: Berakhot 11b. He reported Ammi, who reported Chanina in Rabbi’s name: Bava Batra 130b. He asked Ammi: Chullin 46a. He reported Huna: Sotah 21b. Huna bar Chinena told his son,“When you go to Zerika, ask him.” In Hamnuna’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Sukkah 1. In Zeira’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Keitzad Mevarkhin and Pesachim 1. Chizkiyah in his name; in Chizkiyah’s name, Maaser Sheni 1. In Chanina’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat 1 (see Yehudah Nesia). He reported Yehudah: Beitzah 7b; Ketubbot 88a. In Yose bar Chanina’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Tamid Nishchat 4. Yannai son of Yishmael, in Yochanan’s name. He and Yannai son of Ammi visited Yehudah son of Shimon ben Pazi’s house. In Yaakov bar Idi’s name: Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot 2. With Yaakov son of Bun, many times they resolved matters: Jerusalem Talmud, Kol Gaggot. He objected to Yitzchak Nappacha: Chullin 48b. He applied to Yirmeyah,“Truth, humility and righteousness”: Menachot 88b. Rabbi Mana in his name; Rav Safra in his name.
